configuration_boundary.model_range_facts: Menagerie declares ranges for joints 2, 4, and 6 and actuator control ranges matching those limits; other hinge limits are not copied as task thresholds.

source_registry.facts: Seven joint names, pinch_site, wrist camera, position actuators, home/retract keyframes, and floor scene.

source_status: PUBLIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; MJCF and assets intentionally not vendored in this preparation package

tasks.description: Move the Kinova Gen3 pinch reference to the specified reachable 3-D target and stop.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Single Cartesian reach using the seven-joint serial chain.
tasks.criterion_summary: Pinch-site target error is at most 50 mm for 0.5 s; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Trace a small square in Cartesian space with the Kinova Gen3 pinch reference and return to start.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Reusable G2 path-tracing primitive without object or gripper assumptions.
tasks.criterion_summary: Maximum waypoint and return errors are at most 50 mm; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Move the Kinova Gen3 pinch reference by the specified Cartesian offset, hold, and return.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Reusable bounded offset effect with a trusted terminal return measurement.
tasks.criterion_summary: Offset and return errors are at most 50 mm; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Visit the specified ordered Cartesian waypoints with the Kinova Gen3 pinch reference.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Reusable ordered waypoint primitive for a serial arm.
tasks.criterion_summary: Every waypoint is within 60 mm and order is preserved; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Move the Kinova Gen3 pinch reference to one reachable waypoint and return to the reset pose.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Minimal two-leg serial-arm primitive that exercises return behavior.
tasks.criterion_summary: Waypoint and final return errors are at most 50 mm; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.
